members.name: description
members.doc: One or two short lines under the label.

members.name: meta
members.doc: A price, estimate, or other value. Sits at the end of a list row, or under the text in a grid card.

members.name: icon
members.doc: Plain decorative icon beside the label.

members.name: disabledReason
members.doc: Short reason shown in place of the description when the option is disabled.

types.name: RadioCardsProps
types.doc: Selectable option cards for choices that need more than a label: plans, shipping speeds, regions. One selection ring glides from card to card on a spring, so the eye follows the change. Behaves as a native radio group: one tab stop, arrow keys move and select, and a hidden input carries the value in forms.

members.name: layout
members.doc: "grid" places cards in responsive columns; "list" stacks full width rows.

members.name: minColumnWidth
members.doc: Narrowest a grid column may get before the grid drops a column, in px.

members.name: name
members.doc: Form field name. Renders a hidden input with the selected value.
